title: Target Subset Counter
description: Given non-negative integers and a target sum, count how many different index-based subsets have a total exactly equal to the target. The answer must be printed modulo 1000000007.
inputFormat: First line: n and target. Second line: n non-negative integers.
outputFormat: Print the number of subsets whose sum is exactly target modulo 1000000007.
hints: For each value, count ways that exclude it and ways that include it when the remaining sum permits.

examples.explanation: The subsets {1,4} and {2,3} both sum to 5.
There are four index-based subsets with sum 6.
